#### A Message from Mayor Lee: Oakland is On the Move!
Oaklanders, we’re proud to call The Town our home! Today, Oakland is a safer, more stable, and more hopeful City after just one year.
Working together—Labor and Business, neighbor to neighbor, we’ve made great strides.
I've served you as a Mayor who will root corruption out of City Hall, reopen fire stations, stabilize the City's budget, and ensure city services are delivered.
Now, Oakland has been cited as a national model for community-based gun violence reduction, with homicides and violent crime at historical lows.
In my next four years, I will continue to work towards an Oakland that is a statewide and national model.
An Oakland where residents and stakeholders from every walk of life—including families on a working-class wage, and the small business owners who give our City its character—are not just surviving, but thriving.
I want everyone to achieve their dream of opening a successful business or affording a home here.
Streets are getting cleaner. More good-paying, local jobs. A comprehensive approach to homelessness. More affordable and accessible housing, across our City.
Crime is going down, through a multi-pronged strategy that includes strong prevention programs.
I would be honored to continue to serve as your Mayor—and together, we will continue to work towards an Oakland that is accountable and achieves the results you deserve. We are On the Move!
Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee

## What People are Saying About
Barbara Lee as Oakland’s Mayor
Endorse Barbara Today
#### On Public Safety Leadership
Jesse Arreguín
"Barbara Lee is the leader Oakland needs to tackle its public safety challenges head-on. With a proven commitment to our community, she will increase beat patrols to ensure safer streets, aggressively combat gun violence and human trafficking, and expand investment in vital prevention programs that keep our youth on the right path. Oakland deserves bold, effective leadership, and Barbara Lee delivers.”
—Senator Jesse Arreguín, Chair–State Senate Public Safety Committee
Don Link
“I’m endorsing Barbara Lee for Mayor. She will strengthen community-based policing models that build trust between residents, businesses, and law enforcement to make our neighborhoods stronger and safer.”
—Don Link, Bushrod Resident and Neighborhood Crime Prevention Council Leader
Carlotta Brown
“As Mayor, Barbara Lee will address blight and illegal dumping and restore pride and security to our communities. Her proven ability to bring badly needed resources to Oakland will deliver the results we all need to be safer.”
—Carlotta Brown, Millsmont Resident, Alameda County Status of Women Commissioner and former Public Safety and Services Violence Prevention Oversight Commission Chair
“Barbara Lee’s experience as a small business owner and her accountable, hands-on leadership style will help business owners recover from smash and grabs. We love her plan to reduce red tape and bureaucracy for new businesses wanting to locate here!”
—Owners of Everitt & Jones BBQ, Oakland

Jerry Brown

“We know what it takes to move this city forward. Barbara Lee brings the integrity, accountability, and decades of proven leadership to bring Oaklanders together and address our challenges at this critical time.”
—Former Mayor Elihu Harris
#### Endorsed by Oakland Firefighters
“Barbara Lee is working with public safety leaders and Oakland Firefighters to ensure a comprehensive approach to public safety, protecting 911 services, and working to keep all of our fire stations open.”
—Seth Olyer, President Oakland Firefighters
